work.title: Untitled (Snowman with Plane)
work.description: Mixed-media collage on white paper depicts a tall vertical snowman figure wearing green sunglasses, assembled from torn and layered paper fragments. Collaged strips, a side-profile warplane cutout, heart drawings, postage-stamp-like printed cards, and a bunting of small flags surround the central figure.
work.composition: tall vertical figure centered on white ground
